data.name: LegendPlayer
data.value: You, at your last screenshot: sand disc in a ring. Dashed with its age from 1 min, framed from 2. Cone: your facing (45 s).
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks. The player's position. 'Cone: your facing (45 s)': the cone shows the way the player faced, for 45 seconds.

data.name: LegendKeptQuest
data.value: A picked quest: ringed, in its pick's colour.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks. A pick is a quest the player picked in the list (its pen).

data.name: LegendGuide
data.value: To your picks' nearest place: dashed line in the pick's colour, with the distance.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendOutOfView
data.value: Picked places out of view: chevron in the pick's colour, with a count.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendObjective
data.value: Quest objective: gold disc, its glyph the quest type.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendPossibleLocation
data.value: One of several places it can be: ? at the corner.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendCluster
data.value: Close places of one objective: one marker with a count. Zoom in to split.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendExtract
data.value: Extract for your side: green (PMC) or teal (Scav) triangle.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks. PMC and Scav as the game says them.

data.name: LegendSharedExtract
data.value: Extract for both sides: khaki split triangle.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendExtractListed
data.value: On your extract list this raid: lit, a glow in its colour, name in bold.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks. The extract list is the game's own, read from a screenshot.

data.name: LegendExtractNotListed
data.value: Not on your extract list this raid: struck out, name faint. A ? in the triangle: the game shows ??:??:?? (closed, or needs something).
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks. ??:??:?? is what the game's extract list shows in place of an extract's time: keep it as it is.

data.name: LegendTransit
data.value: Transit to another map: violet diamond.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendPlayerOutOfView
data.value: You, out of view: sand badge at the edge. Click it or press F.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks. F is Shturmap's key for following the player.

data.name: LegendKeptLock
data.value: A door a pick needs a key for: padlock in the pick's colour, with the key's name.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendJoined
data.value: Several objectives of one quest on one spot: one marker, with how many are open.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendOptional
data.value: Optional objective: OPT at the upper left.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks. OPT: the badge's text on the map (MarkerOptionalBadge); write it the same.

data.name: LegendExtractSwitch
data.value: Extract that needs a switch first: power symbol at its lower left. Point at it: its switches light, a dashed line to the first.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks. The power symbol is the switches' own symbol on the map (LegendSwitch).

data.name: LegendDone
data.value: Done objective: small grey disc with a check.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendQuestZone
data.value: An objective's area.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendLeader
data.value: Moved off a crowded spot: a line in its colour to a dot where it is.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendPointedOutOfView
data.value: Places of the quest you point at, out of view: pulsing gold chevron, with a count.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendPing
data.value: A new position: sand rings.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendCompleted
data.value: A quest just completed: its places turn into gold checks, ring out and go.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendBoss
data.value: Boss or AI squad spawn: red octagon, with the chance (and this zone's share).
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendSniper
data.value: Sniper Scav spawns: hollow hexagon.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendScav
data.value: Scav spawns: small ring.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendLock
data.value: Locked door or trunk: padlock, with the key's name when zoomed in. Point at a key to light its locks.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendSwitch
data.value: Switch (power, alarm, elevator, trap): power symbol.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendHazard
data.value: Deadly area (traps, minefields, sniper zones): hatched outline.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendOtherFloor
data.value: On another floor: up or down, with how many when more than one.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendTrail
data.value: Your earlier positions this raid: dashed sand line.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendReplay
data.value: The raid replay, after a raid: your screenshots in order, faint and thin at its start, bright and wide at its end.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendLooseItem
data.value: Where an item lies loose, while you point at it: small open square.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendContainers
data.value: Loot containers, on a map without artwork: faint dots.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks.

data.name: LegendGrid
data.value: The grid: 100 m squares, lettered across and numbered down, each named in its corner; thirds as on a number pad (D5-8 is the top middle of D5).
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks. The squad grid: lines 100 m apart, the columns' letters A to Z (no I or O) along the top and bottom, the rows' numbers along the sides, each square's name (D5) at its top-left corner; each square cut in thirds each way, its nine parts numbered as on a computer's number pad (7 8 9 on top). D5-8 must stay as it is.

data.name: LegendSheet
data.value: No artwork for this map: a sheet from data only, with its grid.
data.comment: Help panel, the map's legend: the line beside the symbol's swatch, what it is and how it looks. The grid is the squad grid's 100 m, or with the grid turned off in settings the sheet's own 10 m.

data.name: MarkerExtract
data.value: Extract
data.comment: Map: the name beside a marker. An extract the data gives no name.

data.name: MarkerTransitTo
data.value: Transit to {map}
data.comment: Map: the name beside a marker. A transit to another map. {map}: that map's name, as the game writes it: Customs.

data.name: MarkerTransitElsewhere
data.value: Transit to another map
data.comment: Map: the name beside a marker. A transit whose map the data doesn't name.

data.name: MarkerLocked
data.value: Locked
data.comment: Map: the name beside a marker. A locked door or trunk whose key the data doesn't name.

data.name: MarkerLockNeedsPower
data.value: {key} · needs power
data.comment: Map: the name beside a marker. A locked door that opens only with the power on. {key}: the key's short name, as the game writes it.

data.name: MarkerLockedNeedsPower
data.value: Locked · needs power
data.comment: Map: the name beside a marker. As MarkerLocked, for a door that opens only with the power on.

data.name: MarkerSwitch
data.value: Switch
data.comment: Map: the name beside a marker. A switch the data gives no name of its own.

data.name: MarkerStepOfExit
data.value: {step} · {exit}
data.comment: Map: the name beside a switch (or a keycard's lock) while the extract it opens is pointed at: what it is, and for which extract. {step}: the switch's name, 'Mall Main Power Switch', or the key's short name; {exit}: the extract's name, 'Saferoom Exfil'.

data.name: MarkerSniper
data.value: Sniper
data.comment: Map: the name beside a marker. Where sniper Scavs spawn.

data.name: MarkerBossChance
data.value: {boss} {chance}%
data.comment: Map: the name beside a marker. Where a boss or AI squad spawns, with its chance on the map; several are joined with " / ". The same format as the plan's line. {boss}: its name, as the game writes it: Kollontay; {chance}: percent, 75.

data.name: MarkerBossChanceHere
data.value: {boss} {chance}% · {here}% here
data.comment: Map: the name beside a marker. As MarkerBossChance, when less applies to this place (a zone's share). {boss}: its name; {chance}: percent on the map, 75; {here}: percent at this place, 50.

data.name: MarkerOptionalBadge
data.value: OPT
data.comment: Map: the badge at the upper left of an optional objective's marker; three or four letters at most. Named in the legend (LegendOptional).

data.name: MapSheetCaption
data.value: NO ARTWORK FOR THIS MAP · GRID {spacing} M
data.comment: Map, top left, on a map without artwork, drawn as a sheet from the data. {spacing}: the grid's spacing in metres, 100 (the squad grid) or 10 (the sheet's own, with the grid turned off).

data.name: MapSheetCaptionNoFloors
data.value: NO ARTWORK FOR THIS MAP · GRID {spacing} M · NO FLOOR DATA
data.comment: As MapSheetCaption, on a map whose data has no floors either (every marker is drawn on one plane). {spacing}: the grid's spacing in metres, 100 or 10.

data.name: MapSniperZone
data.value: SNIPER ZONE
data.comment: Map: the name of a border-sniper area, written across it in spaced capitals.

data.name: MapNewPosition
data.value: YOUR NEW POSITION · PRESS F
data.comment: Map: beside the badge at the view's edge when a new position arrives out of view. F is Shturmap's key for following the player.

data.name: DistanceMetres
data.value: {metres} m
data.comment: A distance under 1 km: the map's guide plate and scale bar, and the cards ("69 m"). {metres}: whole metres, 69.

data.name: DistanceKilometres
data.value: {kilometres} km
data.comment: A distance of 1 km or more, as DistanceMetres. {kilometres}: kilometres with one decimal, 1.2, written in this language's format.

data.name: PlayerAgeMinutes
data.value: {minutes} MIN
data.comment: How old the player's position is, in whole minutes under an hour: 4 MIN. Not on screen by itself at present: the map says it with OLD (PlayerAgeMinutesOld). {minutes}: whole minutes.

data.name: PlayerAgeHours
data.value: {hours} H
data.comment: As PlayerAgeMinutes, in whole hours from an hour on: 2 H. {hours}: whole hours.

data.name: PlayerAgeMinutesOld
data.value: {minutes} MIN OLD
data.comment: Map: a small tag in capitals beside a marker; short. Beside the player's position once it is a minute old: how old it is (never bare minutes, which read as a time to get somewhere). {minutes}: whole minutes.

data.name: PlayerAgeHoursOld
data.value: {hours} H OLD
data.comment: Map: a small tag in capitals beside a marker; short. As PlayerAgeMinutesOld, from an hour on. {hours}: whole hours.

data.name: PlayerTagMinutesOld
data.value: {reference} · {minutes} MIN OLD
data.comment: Map: a small tag in capitals beside the player's position, with the grid on, once the position is a minute old: the grid square and how old the position is; short. {reference}: the square and its ninth, as players say it, D5-8 (the same in every language). {minutes}: whole minutes. As PlayerAgeMinutesOld with the reference before it.

data.name: PlayerTagHoursOld
data.value: {reference} · {hours} H OLD
data.comment: As PlayerTagMinutesOld, from an hour on. {reference}: D5-8. {hours}: whole hours.

data.name: MapGridYou
data.value: YOU
data.comment: Map, top left, with the grid on, while your position is shown: the small label before your grid square in large type ("YOU D5-8 · 2 MIN OLD"), so a squad can be told where you are. Capitals; one short word.

data.name: MapGridPointer
data.value: POINTER
data.comment: Map, top left, with the grid on, while the mouse pointer is over the map: the small label before the grid square under the pointer ("POINTER D5-8"), on a line under "YOU D5-8" in a raid, alone outside one. It names the mouse pointer, not a person or a direction. Capitals; one short word, about as long as the English.

data.name: ReplayMinute
data.value: {minute} MIN IN
data.comment: Map: a small tag in capitals beside a marker; short. The raid replay: a position's minute into the raid. {minute}: whole minutes since the raid's start.

data.name: ReplayLastSeen
data.value: LAST SEEN · {minutes} MIN BEFORE THE END
data.comment: Map: a small tag in capitals beside a marker; short. The raid replay, at its end: on the last position, how long before the raid's end it was taken. {minutes}: whole minutes, 1 or more.

data.name: ReplayLastSeenJustBefore
data.value: LAST SEEN · JUST BEFORE THE END
data.comment: Map: a small tag in capitals beside a marker; short. As ReplayLastSeen, when the last position was taken in the raid's last minute.
